Location Forecast 2026: Orchestrating Seamless Logistics from Planning to Delivery

Quick summary

The logistics industry in 2026 is being transformed by the convergence of location intelligence, AI-powered optimization, and autonomous robotics to create more sustainable and efficient supply chains.

Key takeaways

  • Transportation and logistics account for nearly a quarter of all carbon dioxide emissions, driving sustainability initiatives
  • HERE AI Assistant enables natural language interaction for complex location queries and dynamic route optimization
  • Territory Assignment Optimization (TAO) helps delivery networks maintain stable zones despite demand fluctuations
  • Autonomous robots like Hyundai's MobED and ABB's AMR P603 are becoming production-ready logistics infrastructure
  • Carbon footprint tracking and reusable packaging with smart tracking are emerging as industry standards
